result.detail:
Two items from the verification plan of the microarchitecture spec are out of scope for this rtl_source and testbench task:
- the SymbiYosys proofs (sync_fifo.sby and sync_fifo_depth5.sby)
- the failure-path testbench (sync_fifo_tb_fail.v)

The formal properties are already inside the RTL for the seat that owns the proof. Testbench file order matters: sync_fifo_tb.v is the first testbench file, so its entry, sync_fifo_tb, is the simulation top. All three files carry the same `timescale` to avoid Verilator TIMESCALEMOD. The main residual risk is tool-specific width warnings, or part-select-of-parameter handling, in the testbench or RTL constants.
